column3: NEXT_LOCALE is a non-sensitive language preference read by next-intl middleware (auth cookies are HttpOnly)
Flagged only on 307 locale redirects, which have no body
Search params echo into React-rendered attributes, which React escapes (no raw HTML sinks)
script/style-src 'unsafe-inline' kept so pages stay statically cacheable (ADR-0017); other directives are strict
Anti-clickjacking header (frame-ancestors / X-Frame-Options) must be present
No wildcard CORS on the web origin
